selectedOriginals.caption: Grauman's Chinese Theatre
selectedOriginals.inspection: Full original individually inspected. Tall single swept hipped green-bronze pagoda roof, short ridge/two tall trident finials and upturned corner blades. White curved cornice and flared stepped coral/gold bracket panels over two massive square coral columns. Open-mouthed black/bronze masks with tusks/whiskers/horns wrap front and side. Deep portico, dragon relief/round gong, golden lower doors with separate small swept canopy/sun halo; two pale guardian lions. Lower wings have square-grid windows/red curved roof bands. Adjacent white block is excluded.

selectedOriginals.caption: A panorama of Grauman's Chinese Theater in Hollywood
selectedOriginals.inspection: Full2012-07-18wide original individually inspected. Open forecourt between two tall street-front gateway blocks. Large faceted green-bronze obelisk on each inner block, shorter pinnacles on outer ends, carved pale bands/pointed arch shop entrances and vertical CHINESE blades. Curved walls with niches/flame reliefs lead toward central pagoda; rear auditorium belongs to same theater. Handprints/film advertisements/people/rail barriers omitted; neutral boards retain geometry.

additionalInspected.caption: Grauman's Chinese Theatre 3
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2014-10-03oblique original individually inspected. Main swept hipped roof is one roof, not stacked tiers. Outward-stepped white corbel caps with orange/gold panels, actual open portico/grid ceiling, square coral columns and large black open mask heads wrapping sides. Round gong/pendants hang under lintel; tall central stone dragon panel/deep grey ribs and lower sun disk with small canopy. Slender high corner blades have open gaps, not solid cones.

additionalInspected.caption: Grauman's Chinese Theatre 5
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2014-10-03court-wall original individually inspected. Curved pale stucco wall, raised piers/thin horizontal bands, recessed shallow pointed niche carrying hanging bronze ornament and projecting pale boat-shaped bracket, black branching flame wall plaques with coral roundels and dangling bell branches; short green fluted pinnacles with leaf finials. Plants/film signage excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Grauman's Chinese Theatre 6
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2014-10-03street-wing original individually inspected. Tall faceted bronze obelisk with open flame finial, pale wall/three carved bands, long black vertical CHINESE blade with gold channel letters/pattern border and small roof cap. Lower pointed arch framed by dragons/temple relief; blank static marquee board below projecting dark bronze niche canopy with hanging bells. Modern neighboring advertising excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Grauman's Chinese Theatre Door
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2014-10-03door original individually inspected. Golden double doors each have tall dark glazed viewing slot within raised tiny pagoda-shaped frame, central paired handle/round escutcheon and lower kickplate. Fine incised landscape omitted; original abstract geometric trim substitutes at close distance.
